summary: A candidate hands papers to a clerk who checks them and says what comes next.
realLife: County clerks take school board and council papers in a fixed window, with the signatures, fee and residency checked.
sources: Laramie County (Wyoming) Clerk, candidate filing for school and college boards: https://laramiecountywy.gov/Press-Release/County-Clerk-announces-candidate-filing-for-school-and-college-boards-Aug.-7-through-26
